name: claude-fleet
description: Report every Claude Code session to Home Assistant over MQTT: live status, tokens, plan limits and RTK savings on a wall dashboard.

mqtt_host.title: MQTT broker host
mqtt_host.description: The broker Home Assistant uses, e.g. homeassistant.local

mqtt_user.title: MQTT user
mqtt_user.description: A broker login for your computers

mqtt_password.title: MQTT password
mqtt_password.description: That user's password. Stored as a sensitive value, not in a plain-text file

machine_name.title: This computer's name on the dashboard
machine_name.description: Must be different on each computer. Blank uses the computer's own name.

stale_minutes.title: Minutes of silence before a working session shows as stale
stale_minutes.description: 20 on an always-on machine; 0 on a laptop, where a closed lid is not a stuck session

summaries.title: One-line 'working on' summaries
summaries.description: Sends the tail of each session's transcript to Haiku (via claude -p) every ~10 minutes and publishes a one-line summary
